MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

2. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 2

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 169

5. Solve for x: x + 5 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 5
   D. 4

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

8. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 5
   C. 13
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 49
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 0.25

3. C — 10
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 6² + 8²
3. c² = 36 + 64
4. c² = 100
5. c = 10
Final Answer: 10 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

4. D — 169
Working:

2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169

Working:

2. Substitute values: x = 9 − 5

Final Answer: x = 4
